---
- name: Create temporary values file
  ansible.builtin.tempfile:
    state: file
    suffix: "-cilium-values.yaml"
  register: cilium_values_tmp
- name: Template Cilium values file
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: cilium-values.yaml.j2
    dest: "{{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}"
    mode: "0600"
- name: Verify Helm is installed
  ansible.builtin.command: helm version --short
  register: cilium_helm_version
  changed_when: false
- name: Add Cilium Helm repository
  ansible.builtin.command: helm repo add cilium {{ cilium_chart_repo }}
  register: cilium_helm_repo_add
  changed_when: "'has been added' in cilium_helm_repo_add.stdout"
  failed_when: cilium_helm_repo_add.rc != 0 and 'already exists' not in cilium_helm_repo_add.stderr
- name: Update Helm repositories
  ansible.builtin.command: helm repo update
  register: cilium_helm_repo_update
  changed_when: "'Update Complete' in cilium_helm_repo_update.stdout"
- name: Install/upgrade Cilium with Helm
  ansible.builtin.command: >
    helm upgrade --install cilium cilium/{{ cilium_chart_name }}
    --version {{ cilium_version }}
    --namespace {{ cilium_namespace }}
    --create-namespace
    --values {{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}
    --kubeconfig /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml

  register: cilium_helm_install
  changed_when: >
    "'STATUS: deployed' in cilium_helm_install.stdout or
    'STATUS: upgraded' in cilium_helm_install.stdout"
- name: Wait for Cilium DaemonSet to be created
  ansible.builtin.command: k3s kubectl -n {{ cilium_namespace }} get ds cilium
  register: cilium_ds_check
  until: cilium_ds_check.rc == 0
  retries: "{{ cilium_wait_retries | default(60) }}"
  delay: "{{ cilium_wait_delay | default(5) }}"
  changed_when: false
- name: Wait for cilium pods
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    k3s kubectl -n {{ cilium_namespace }} rollout status ds/cilium
    --timeout="{{ cilium_rollout_timeout }}s"
  register: cilium_rollout
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: cilium_rollout.rc != 0
- name: Remove temporary values file
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ cilium_values_tmp.path }}"
    state: absent
  changed_when: false
- name: Show node status
  ansible.builtin.command: k3s kubectl get nodes -o wide
  register: cilium_nodes_out
  changed_when: false
